en.description:
Find the perfect path to paint the grids in this lightweight logic game

Snake Paint is a brain-teasing offline puzzle game that is simple to learn but hard to master. Your mission: direct your snake to travel over every single square on the board in as few moves as possible. Can you paint the entire grid without getting stuck?

With over 200+ handcrafted levels, the puzzles start with simple paths and evolve into complex mechanical labyrinths that will test your spatial reasoning.

Dynamic Puzzle Mechanics:

- Paint the Path: Every move leaves a trail of color. You haven't won until every square is filled.

- Narrow Passageways: Navigate tight board elements that limit your movement and force you to plan your route carefully.

• Movable Boulders: Push obstacles out of your way to clear a path—but be careful! Don't push them into a corner that still needs paint.

• Rotating Walls: Timing is everything. The walls may turn, but keep your tail in mind—if your snake is in the way, it will block the wall’s path!

Why Play Snake Paint?

• Ultra-Lightweight: At under 30MB, this game takes up almost no storage space.

• Play Anywhere: Internet optional. Enjoy the full game entirely offline.

• Brain Training: Sharpen your mind with logic puzzles with easy and hard modes.

• Hint System: Stuck on a tricky level? Watch a quick video to get the solution and move on to the next level.

• Clean Visuals: Minimalist graphics and smooth animations for a focused, distraction-free experience.

How to Play:

1. Swipe or use the directional arrows to move the snake.

2. Push the boulders and rotate the walls to get to every square.

3. Cover every square on the board with paint.

Solve the puzzle and unlock the next challenge!
en.releaseNotes: Updated optimal puzzle solutions and added best score markers
